name: Funeral for Later
why_it_works: Most people don't say no to a service; they say 'later'. A deadpan funeral for the stalling phrase makes the delay visible and a little absurd, and the real bill that waiting ran up turns 'someday' into a price the viewer can feel. Burying it and naming today as the replacement gives them a clean, guilt-free reason to act now.

hook.pattern: Open on a tiny tombstone carved with the customer's stalling phrase and a solemn, deadpan farewell.
examples: Rest in peace, "{{stall_phrase}}". You cost a lot.
Dearly beloved, we gather to bury "{{stall_phrase}}".

variables.name: stall_phrase
variables.description: The exact phrase customers use to put it off, starting with a capital letter, 4 words or fewer

variables.name: task
variables.description: The job being put off, lowercase, 5 words or fewer

variables.name: delay_cost
variables.description: What waiting typically turns into, from your own real jobs, lowercase, 10 words or fewer
variables.example: a $40 pad swap turned into a $400 brake job

variables.name: today_step
variables.description: One small thing to do today, starting with a capital-letter verb, 6 words or fewer

variables.name: disclosure
variables.description: Fine-print disclosure line for the client's regulated niche (use the matching compliance pack's disclosure line)
variables.example: Results vary. Consult a licensed provider.

visual.prompt: Vertical 9:16 close-up of a tiny grey stone tombstone engraved 'R.I.P.' on the front counter at {{brand}}, a single white lily beside it, moody side light, tongue-in-cheek solemn
Vertical 9:16 photo of a wall calendar with several months crossed out and a sticky note reading 'later', dim afternoon light, quiet mood, no people

Vertical 9:16 comedic shot of the {{brand}} team in work clothes standing in a line, hands over hearts, deadpan faces, one person slowly lowers a tiny bouquet, slow push-in, practical workplace lighting
Vertical 9:16 photo of the welcoming front desk at {{brand}}, open appointment book and a pen, warm daylight, the tiny tombstone in soft focus at the edge

craft.notes: Play it completely straight: solemn voice, slow pace, one lily. The joke is the gap between a full ceremony and a three-word excuse. The bill beat is the turn, so use a real, typical figure from your own work, then end on a step small enough to do today.

do_not: Shame people who put things off; the viewer is one of them
Invent scary costs or worst cases you can't back with real jobs
Use real funeral imagery such as a cemetery, casket or hearse
compliance: Dental offices: no promises of pain-free care or specific outcomes; describe the visit and add 'results vary' next to any outcome
Tax preparers: no refund size, savings or penalty-avoidance promises; label any figure as an example
Cost examples must be real, typical figures from the business, labelled as examples, never a guaranteed price
